title: Made 443 free 3D models with Claude: GLB, glTF, OBJ and STL, CC BY 4.0
author: vinishkapoor
selftext:
I’ve been making low-poly 3D models with Claude for my browser games, and I’ve put them all on one page for anyone to use.

* 443 models in 39 categories: War Zone, Dungeon Kit, Furniture, Animals, Robots and more
* GLB, glTF, OBJ+MTL and STL
* Direct downloads, no account, CC BY 4.0 (just credit vinish.dev)
* A 3D preview for each model, with rotate, zoom and wireframe

[https://vinish.dev/free-3d-models](https://vinish.dev/free-3d-models)

Curious if anyone else is making 3D assets with AI, and how you handle getting consistent style across a big set.

comments.author: Affectionate_Pass231
comments.body:
https://i.redd.it/0gz3evm4ut2i1.png

I've had a lot of success with IgorAherne's fusion of the TRELLIS and StableProjectorz project (*https://github.com/IgorAherne/trellis-stable-projectorz*). Despite claiming a 16gb VRAM requirement it runs really fast on a 12gb 4070 (around 2 minutes or so incl. textures). Consistency is really down to your image generation workflow with this method usually some flux klein edits are necessary.
